publications.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Protein Structure Prediction in Low-Resource Settings
publications.abstract: We present a novel deep learning framework for protein structure prediction that achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly reduced computational resources.

publications.title: Efficient Transformer Architectures for Bangla Natural Language Processing
publications.abstract: This paper introduces a compact transformer model fine-tuned for Bangla NLP tasks, outperforming larger multilingual models across six benchmarks.

publications.title: Remote Sensing Based Flood Detection Using Synthetic Aperture Radar
publications.venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
publications.abstract: A real-time flood mapping pipeline using SAR imagery and convolutional neural networks, evaluated on Bangladesh flood events from 2017–2023.

publications.title: Graph Neural Networks for Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
publications.abstract: We propose a graph-based model for predicting adverse drug-drug interactions, trained on a curated dataset of 300,000 compound pairs.

publications.title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Medical Image Analysis
publications.abstract: A federated learning framework for chest X-ray classification that maintains diagnostic accuracy while ensuring patient data never leaves hospital servers.
